description: This file contains PHPUnit test cases for the EmployeeOnLeaveTodayConfigAPI class, which is a part of the OrangeHRM Dashboard API v2. It tests the 'getOne' and 'update' API endpoints related to employee leave configuration, as well as some unimplemented delete functionality.

classes.name: EmployeeOnLeaveTodayConfigAPITest
classes.description: Test suite for the EmployeeOnLeaveTodayConfigAPI class, extending EndpointIntegrationTestCase and including methods to test API endpoints for getting, updating, and deleting employee leave configuration.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests the 'getOne' API endpoint to retrieve employee leave configuration data.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests the 'update' API endpoint to modify employee leave configuration data.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests that the delete method is not implemented and throws an exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Tests the validation rules for delete, which are not implemented, expecting an exception.

methods.name: configEnablingPreHook
methods.description: Pre-configuration hook to set specific configuration value in the database for testing purposes.
